children: ServiceTitan reported fiscal second quarter 2027 revenue of $292.8 million, up 21% year‑over‑year, and GAAP loss from operations of $27.6 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026. Non‑GAAP income from operations was $44.4 million with non‑GAAP operating margin of 15.2%, and non‑GAAP diluted EPS of $0.40. The company generated $58.0 million of GAAP net cash provided by operating activities and $50.5 million of non‑GAAP free cash flow in the quarter.
Total revenue: $292.8 million for fiscal second quarter 2027 (21% year‑over‑year growth).
Gross profit: GAAP gross profit $209.1 million for the quarter; GAAP gross margin 71.4% and non‑GAAP gross margin 74.6% for the quarter.
Operating results: GAAP loss from operations $(27.6) million; non‑GAAP income from operations $44.4 million and non‑GAAP operating margin 15.2% for the quarter.
Net income / EPS: GAAP net loss $(24.9) million; non‑GAAP net income $39.7 million and non‑GAAP diluted net income per share $0.40 for the quarter.

Cash flow and liquidity: GAAP net cash provided by operating activities $58.0 million; non‑GAAP free cash flow $50.5 million for the quarter. Cash and cash equivalents $479.5 million as of July 31, 2026.
Gross transaction volume (GTV) totaled $26.8 billion for the quarter, a 17% year‑over‑year increase, reflecting platform activity processed through ServiceTitan.
Platform revenue was $284.5 million, up 22% year‑over‑year, driven by subscription and usage growth across the platform.
Net dollar retention remained above 110%, indicating continued expansion with existing customers.

Execution on product strategy: company emphasized delivery of its "Agentic Operating System" and AI investments (including Max), citing improved organizational velocity and AI-driven enhancements to customer solutions.
Customer program growth: exceeded goal of doubling Max locations during Q2 and now expects to end the fiscal year with over 700 enrolled Max locations.
